head: 예금과 적금, 금리를 비교하기 전에 알아야 할 차이
prompt: A realistic overhead flat-lay photo on a wooden desk: on the left side, a clear glass jar filled with a single large stack of coins (representing a lump-sum deposit), and on the right side, a row of twelve small glass jars each holding a few coins in ascending amounts (representing monthly installment saving). Soft natural window light from the upper left casting gentle shadows, shot with a 50mm lens at eye-level-45-degree angle, shallow depth of field, no text or labels visible anywhere, candid amateur smartphone-photo look with slightly warm color tone.
alt: 동전이 가득 든 큰 유리병 하나와 조금씩 늘어나는 작은 유리병 12개가 나란히 놓인 모습으로 예금과 적금의 차이를 표현한 사진

head: 금리 비교할 때 반드시 확인해야 할 4가지 기준
prompt: A realistic close-up photo of a Korean woman in her 30s sitting at a home desk, holding a smartphone in one hand and a pen in the other, looking thoughtfully at the phone screen which is angled away from the camera so no text is readable. alt: 한국 여성이 책상에서 스마트폰과 메모장을 보며 여러 조건을 꼼꼼히 따져보는 모습

head: 이자 실수령액, 이렇게 계산해보세요
prompt: A realistic photo of a Korean woman in her late 20s at a small cafe table, using a physical calculator with one hand while holding a pen in the other, the calculator's display tilted away from the camera so digits are not readable. Beside the calculator is an open notebook with only scribbled lines and circles, not legible text, and a smartphone lying face-down on the table. Warm afternoon sunlight streaming in from a nearby window, shot from a slightly elevated angle, soft bokeh in the background, candid lifestyle photography feel.
alt: 한국 여성이 카페에서 계산기와 메모장을 이용해 이자 금액을 직접 계산해보는 모습
